steps.headline: Weimar 2077: a dust town of gravel, glowing screens and a dead Ilm
steps.outlook: Weimar ends as a hot dust-town with a dead river, and its only hope is a lab of students rebuilding from scrap.

observed.pattern: Paint thinner down drains and car washing beside the river continue
observed.assumption: The last pools of the Ilm turn toxic; the bed becomes a cracked chemical scar

observed.pattern: Lawns graveled at Van de Velde and Liszt House, trees felled in backyards
observed.assumption: Heat and dust close over the old town; shade survives only in fragments

observed.pattern: Noon watering, AC with open windows, screens on all night
observed.assumption: Water and power are wasted while the city overheats; brownouts darken whole blocks

observed.pattern: Idling engines and parking circles around the library and theatre
observed.assumption: Car loops persist even as the town empties, and smog settles at dusk

observed.pattern: New Bauhaus students arrive in a hot, broken town
observed.assumption: They squat in shade, rig solar and sort scrap, a small stubborn seed amid the decline

changes.title: The Ilm runs dry
changes.story: Thinner and car-wash suds poisoned the last pools; by 2077 the Ilm is a cracked, stained bed with dust devils

changes.title: Gravel desert at Van de Velde
changes.story: The last lawns were graveled; the campus edge is now stone heat and sand drifts, with SUVs still circling

changes.title: Brownout flats at Goetheplatz
changes.story: AC with open windows and screens left on overloaded the grid; blocks now go dark in the evening heat

changes.title: Student scrap-solar lab
changes.story: New students turn the phone graveyard into a lab, wiring old panels for shade and sorting e-waste
